summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Chrome session against https://autopilot.local/kontakt/ with every non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS request blocked. The page returned HTTP 200; one initialized Contact Form 7 form was visible; all four sourced controls (text, email, telephone and message) and the submit control were visible, enabled and individually focusable; a response region exists; and there were no console errors, page errors, failed requests or mutating requests. Submission was intentionally not triggered, so no email or business side effect occurred. The frozen map source declares no reactions or hyperlink, so no map click behavior was inferred or tested.
